rca_of_issue: EFT diagram blank box — RCA: the EFT config endpoint /api/emotional-gatekeeper/eft/config returns diagram_image_url pointing to a 3rd-party WordPress site (eftinternational.org). That host now responds to non-browser-fingerprinted requests (including iframes/react-native-web Image loads from a different origin) with a Cloudflare-style HTTP 202 + text/html anti-bot challenge instead of the JPEG. React Native Web's <Image> swallows the load error silently, producing an empty 280px-tall box. Mitigation: host the diagram on our own /api/static/eft/ path (the EFT screen already special-cases /api/static/eft/ for videos) OR switch to a license-cleared CDN image; then the existing <Image> code will render correctly with no frontend changes.
